fields.Name: Conversations: Fork
fields.Description: Lets a person start a fork of a conversation: Fork from here, and Edit or Regenerate as a fork. Without it, Edit and Regenerate change the latest turn in place, and the person can still read and write in forks other people made. Granted to the UI role; deny it to a role to turn forking off for its members. Enforced by the server when an MJ: Conversation Branches row is created.
